mapper.select: select system_user_post.id, system_user_post.post_id, system_user_post.user_id, system_post.name as postName from system_user_post left join system_post on system_post.id = system_user_post.post_id where system_user_post.user_id = #{id} and system_user_post.deleted = 0 and system_user_post.status=0
